answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 138 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the velvet. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the ocean queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. The zenith index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A farm of 137 pays that 66 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
